Subject: Supplier onboarding: DPA / SOC2 / PO path?

Hi Markus,

We're starting activation on our side and Procurement needs the security/privacy pack before we can route a PO: specifically a countersigned DPA (or DocuSign link), the latest SOC 2 report, and your current subprocessor registry. Can you also confirm the vendor remit address and vendor ID we should put on our PO template?

Attached is our standard PO template so you can confirm required fields: ProcurePoint_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (xlsx).

Because this is a regulated transaction for our payments service team, they'd like the DPA and SOC2 to be available by EOD Thursday, 12/3. Please let us know the right legal contact if we need to send redlines.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Jones
Sr. Procurement Manager
ProcurePoint Ltd
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: ProcurePoint_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the PO template.

Summary / items attached:
- DPA: attached as Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (we prefer DocuSign for signature; link below).
- Subprocessors: redwood_subprocessors_20261201.csv (current snapshot).
- SOC 2 Type II (most recent) is hosted internally; public link included below for download.
- Vendor activation checklist attached for your AP team.

PO routing / vendor fields: please include Vendor ID: RDW-11234 in the PO and send the PO to invoices@redwood.ai. Our AP team processes vendor POs within 5 business days of receiving a valid PO + W9/KYC. If you need a specific remit address for the PO, use: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1201 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103.

Legal contact for DPA redlines: aditya_rao@redwood.ai (cc'd). If you prefer to propose changes, send redlines as a Word doc and we'll triage.

DocuSign link (preferred for fast turn): https://docusign.com/link/NDK-9a2b-2026-dpa
SOC2 report: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (pdf), redwood_subprocessors_20261201.csv (csv), vendor-activation-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if you want me to loop Finance to confirm billing codes or SLA/financing items.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partners & Procurement

Thanks — received the links and attachments. Legal reviewed the DPA and we have a small set of redlines focused on data retention limits and deletion obligations; I attached the Word file with inline comments. Can you confirm who will own the negotiation on your side?

Also: two quick clarifications for AP:
- Is the remit address you provided the address we should print on the PO?
- Will you accept our PO numbering (we'll include our PO# on the invoice), or do you require any additional vendor references?

Attached: ProcurePoint_DPA_Redlines_12-02.docx (docx)

Appreciate a fast turn if legal can review. We need the signed DPA (or agreed redlines) before we route the PO next week.

Emily

Hi Emily — looping in AP and confirming next steps.

Action items & timeline:
- Legal (aditya_rao) will review your DPA redlines and respond within 48 business hours. If there are material changes, we'll propose tracked changes and a short call if needed.
- For PO processing: please include Vendor ID RDW-11234 on the PO and send the signed PO to invoices@redwood.ai. Our AP team (invoices@redwood.ai) will confirm receipt and estimated payment terms. We accept your PO# on the invoice; no additional vendor reference is required beyond RDW-11234.
- Remit address: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1201 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103. If you need a W9 or KYC packet, request it from invoices@redwood.ai and we'll provide it.
- Docusign: for speed please sign via this link: https://docusign.com/link/NDK-9a2b-2026-dpa. If you prefer to push redlines first, Legal will prioritize review.

I've attached our internal vendor-activation-checklist to help Procurement confirm they've supplied all fields we need to activate you in our system. Once Legal signs off we'll activate the vendor record and AP will route the invoice flow.

Attachments: vendor-activation-checklist.pdf

Thanks — kim
